from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
import torch.nn.functional as F
def run(rank, ws):

    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab

    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=128, hidden_size=64, intermediate_size=128, num_hidden_layers=5, num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2)
    model = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg); ref = copy.deepcopy(model)
    x = torch.randint(0,128,(8,16)); y = torch.randint(0,128,(8,16))
    xs, ys = list(x.chunk(4)), list(y.chunk(4))
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(model, xs, ys, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
    rl = 0
    for a,b in zip(xs,ys):
        l = F.cross_entropy(ref(a).logits.reshape(-1,128), b.reshape(-1))/4; l.backward(); rl += l.item()
    md = 0
    for (n,p),(_,q) in zip(model.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
        if p.grad is not None: md = max(md, (p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
    print(rank, "loss", loss, rl, "maxdiff", md)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=="__main__":
    for ws in (1,2): mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws)
